# Break and Steal an Egg Wiki

> Honest guide to Break and Steal an Egg: how free rewards really work (no text codes), beginner tips, and pet coverage re-verified after every update.

Wiki for Break and Steal an Egg (Roblox, by ILGames x Eggs). Articles cover boss guides, tier lists, codes, items, and beginner tips.

## Articles

- [Break and Steal an Egg Codes (October 2026) — The Truth + Real Free Rewards](https://wenta0v0-dot.github.io/breakegg-guide/codes/all-codes/): Break and Steal an Egg has no text codes as of October 12, 2026 — the game has no code box to type into. The real free rewards are the Discord-link Saber-tooth Egg and the like-and-join-group bonus. This page proves both claims, walks through each step, and is re-verified after every game update.
- [Break and Steal an Egg Beginner Guide — Core Loop, Zones & Upgrades](https://wenta0v0-dot.github.io/breakegg-guide/guides/beginner-guide/): Break and Steal an Egg is a heist wrapped in a pet collector: break eggs to hatch rare animals, steal other players' animals, escape the guards, and park loot in your base to earn cash. This guide walks through the full loop, the known zones, which upgrades to buy first, and the mistakes that cost new players their animals.
